criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being, including historical figures, artists, politicians, athletes, etc.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: An entity such as a company, institution, or group formed for a specific purpose.

categories.name: Event
categories.definition: A specific occurrence or happening, often historical or cultural, such as a concert, festival, or competition.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: A specific place or geographic area, including cities, countries, natural features, and man-made structures.

categories.name: Work of Art
categories.definition: A creative work, including films, books, music albums, and paintings.

categories.name: Species
categories.definition: A group of living organisms consisting of similar individuals capable of exchanging genes or interbreeding.

categories.name: Plant
categories.definition: A living organism of the kind exemplified by trees, shrubs, herbs, grasses, ferns, and mosses, typically growing in a permanent site.

categories.name: Animal
categories.definition: A living organism that feeds on organic matter, typically having specialized sense organs and nervous system and able to respond rapidly to stimuli.

categories.name: Building
categories.definition: A structure with a roof and walls, such as a house, school, or factory.

categories.name: Vehicle
categories.definition: A means of transporting goods or people, such as a car, ship, or aircraft.

categories.name: Publication
categories.definition: A work that is published, such as a book, journal, or newspaper.

categories.name: Technology
categories.definition: The application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

categories.name: Historical Period
categories.definition: A distinct period of time in history characterized by particular events, developments, or figures.

categories.name: Cultural Practice
categories.definition: A traditional or customary practice or activity within a culture or society.
